newsitem.title: USA: Oilex sets acquistion, seeks financing.
newsitem.headline: Oilex sets acquistion, seeks financing.

text.p: Oilex Inc said Thursday it has agreed to acquire properties of privately owned Geronimo Holding Corp in exchange for, among other things, a cash payment of $15.3 million plus 15 million Oilex common shares.
The company is also negotiating for $50 million of financing based on future oil production, which will be used to fund the Geronimo purchase, Allen Burditt II told Reuters in a telephone interview.
He's the sole owner of Phoenix Reserves Inc, which owned 51 percent of Oilex's stock prior to a recent recent property acquistions.
Burditt said the Geronimo transaction will reduce Phoenix's interest in Oilex to about 35 percent of the 43 million shares that will be outstanding after the acquistion.

Oilex said it will acquire 655 oil and natural gas wells, 240,000 acres of gross acreage leases, oil reserves of 500 million barrels and natural gas reserves of 4.5 trillion Cubic Feet situated on 302 leases in 13 states.
The company said the Geronimo property is expected to gemerat $16 million in 1997 positive cash flow.
Burditt said the expected financing would also be used to fund $20 million of infill drilling in 1997, $5 million for recompletions and $10 million for other acquisitions.
The company also said it has entered into a management contract with Xeric Oil and Gas Corp of Midland, Texas, to manage and operate all present and future oil and natural gas wells and leases.

Oilex President Oliver Timmins, said, "The management contract signed with Xeric, which has a full staff of geologists, engineers, administrative and support staff, lifts a huge burden off the day to day operations of Oilex which now owns with this acquisition over 1200 wells."
Burditt said the agreement relieves Oilex's staff of all day-to-day functions "except writting payroll checks."
Xeric's president, Randall Capps, is a member Oilex's board, the company noted.
It said the Geronimo acquisition is contingent upon Oilex finalizing financing arrangements in progress.
